meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等改动类工具时，comment-checker 会发出警告并给出阻断性反馈，让 Codex 先修复或解释被标记的注释再继续。该插件不暴露 MCP 工具。
howto.when: 当 Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等改动类工具后，PostToolUse 钩子触发；非改动类工具会被该插件忽略。

say.text: comment-checker 报了警告，帮我看看并改掉那条注释
say.note: Codex 会先处理被标记的注释再继续

say.text: 解释一下刚才 comment-checker 标记的那条注释
say.note: Codex 给出说明而非直接修改

say.text: 把被标记的注释修掉，然后接着做后面的事

howto.what_en: After Codex successfully runs apply_patch, write, edit and similar edit tools, the PostToolUse hook makes comment-checker warn: Codex gets blocking feedback and should fix or explain the flagged comment before moving on. No MCP tool is exposed.
howto.when_en: Triggers after Codex successfully finishes an edit-like tool call such as apply_patch, write or edit; non-edit tools are ignored by this plugin.

say_en.text: comment-checker flagged a warning — help me review and fix that comment
say_en.note: Codex handles the flagged comment first

say_en.text: Explain the comment comment-checker just flagged
Fix the flagged comment, then continue with the rest
